name: Power Jammer - Crit DMG
RelatedDescription: A miniaturized power supply unit that can be attached to an ST to raise its load limit. Also integrates a function that affects the enemy's Crit DMG capability.

61013.name: Power Boost III · Crit DMG
61013.SpecificEffects:
ST gains an extra <color=#F74848>300</color> Power.
In combat, the enemy's Crit DMG <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
